'''Cara Raeth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Vryim? He's dead? No. Oh, but I think I knew. I think I felt something when he died. Something that drew me out of the city to this place. I just didn't understand until now. Oh, Vryim. I'll miss you.|Cara Raeth, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" />}}
By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Cara Raeth lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with her husband, [[Vryim Raeth]], a vehicle repairman. Sometime that year, Vryim was kidnapped by a criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]] and taken to the [[First Elite Council Bunker]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. The criminals had been under the suspicion that he possessed too much knowledge about their organization and were planning to use him in their experiments as a result. Quickly discovering Vryim had no knowledge of their organization, they assassinated him. Cara Raeth spent weeks attempting to follow her husband's trail, leading her to the First Elite Council Bunker, where she asked a spacer to enter the bunker and rescue her husband. The spacer only found the body of the dead Vryim Raeth inside, which they reported to Cara.<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cara Raeth appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cara Raeth was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
